meetings.label: August 10, 2026
items: Certified and classified union contracts ratified
FY27 Tentative Budget presented ($47,988,866 in revenues, $48,682,866 in expenses) and placed on public display, with the hearing set for September 21
Administrative Costs Resolution approved after a public hearing at which no visitors spoke
Mrs. Erika Snediker sworn in as a newly appointed board member
Back to School Bash drew an estimated 2,000+ attendees and more than $20,000 in donations

Hearing & Board Business: Administrative Costs Resolution hearing held 6:30–6:33 PM; Director of Business/CSBO Frank Adams presented the Resolution to Waive Limitation of Administrative Costs
Visitors raised no questions or comments at the hearing
Board President Ms. White administered the oath of office to newly appointed board member Mrs. Erika Snediker
Finance: Mr. Adams presented the FY27 Tentative Budget: revenues of $47,988,866 and expenses of $48,682,866
Prior-year revenue and expense figures were unaudited, with the audit scheduled for September
Mr. Adams described the district's overall fund balance as healthy and the district as financially stable
Board approved placing the tentative budget on public display and authorized notice of the September 21 public hearing
Contracts: Ratification of the Classified Union Contract approved
Ratification of the Certified Union Contract approved
2026-2027 Assistant Principal Contract for Beach Park Middle School approved
Every action item passed with all five members present voting aye
Superintendent's Report: Back to School Bash: early attendance estimates above 2,000, and more than $20,000 in donations to reduce costs for the four participating districts; a follow-up meeting planned for September
Registration: the latest outreach to unregistered families brought 75 new registrations in one day
New hire orientation: more than 25 new employees took part in three days of learning, team building and classroom or office preparation
Teacher Institute Days set for August 17–18 at Beach Park Middle School
Committee Reports: Long-Range Planning: new electronic sign at Oak Crest installed and operating; Kenneth Murphy East Playground renovation awaiting G&S; Newport sidewalk project (concrete and handrails) complete
Finance: reviewed and approved the bills
SEDOL: Dr. Jennifer Thomas is SEDOL's new superintendent
Consent Agenda: Monthly financials, bills, and personnel report
Regular and closed session minutes of June 15, 2026
Minutes of the June 22, 2026 special morning and afternoon sessions, open and closed
Also Noted: Four members present at roll call, with Mrs. Butler and Mrs. Ropers absent; five voted once Mrs. Snediker was sworn in
Closed session 7:03–7:29 PM on employment matters under 5 ILCS 120/2(c)(1)
During visitor comments, BPD3 Leadership thanked the board and superintendent for their work with the association on the contract
